parameters.query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "SimpleTexting_Campaign_State" (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  ghl_contact_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  campaign_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'enrolled',
  current_step INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  last_template_key TEXT,
  last_sent_at TIMESTAMPTZ,
  provider_message_id TEXT,
  phone_at_send TEXT,
  stop_reason TEXT,
  run_id TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW(),
  UNIQUE (ghl_contact_id, campaign_key)
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "SimpleTexting_Campaign_Event_Log" (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  ghl_contact_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  campaign_key TEXT NOT NULL,
  event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  step_number INT,
  template_key TEXT,
  provider_message_id TEXT,
  details JSONB,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT NOW()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS simpletexting_campaign_state_idx_status ON "SimpleTexting_Campaign_State" (status);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS simpletexting_campaign_event_idx_contact ON "SimpleTexting_Campaign_Event_Log" (ghl_contact_id, campaign_key, created_at DESC);

INSERT INTO "SimpleTexting_Campaign_State" (ghl_contact_id, campaign_key, status, current_step, last_template_key, last_sent_at, provider_message_id, phone_at_send, stop_reason, run_id, updated_at)
VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,CASE WHEN $6 IS NOT NULL THEN NOW() ELSE NULL END,$6,$7,$8,$9,NOW())
ON CONFLICT (ghl_contact_id, campaign_key)
DO UPDATE SET
  status = EXCLUDED.status,
  current_step = EXCLUDED.current_step,
  last_template_key = EXCLUDED.last_template_key,
  last_sent_at = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.last_sent_at, "SimpleTexting_Campaign_State".last_sent_at),
  provider_message_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.provider_message_id, "SimpleTexting_Campaign_State".provider_message_id),
  phone_at_send = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.phone_at_send, "SimpleTexting_Campaign_State".phone_at_send),
  stop_reason = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.stop_reason, "SimpleTexting_Campaign_State".stop_reason),
  run_id = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.run_id, "SimpleTexting_Campaign_State".run_id),
  updated_at = NOW();
INSERT INTO "SimpleTexting_Campaign_Event_Log" (ghl_contact_id, campaign_key, event_type, step_number, template_key, provider_message_id, details)
VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$10::jsonb);
